locations.name: Sunlit Meadow
locations.description: A wide meadow filled with tall grass and wildflowers. The air is warm and quiet.

locations.name: Forest Edge
locations.description: The trees grow denser here. Birdsong mixes with the occasional snap of a twig.

locations.name: Old Trade Road
locations.description: A packed-dirt road that has seen better days. Wagon ruts are still visible.

locations.name: Whispering Pine Thicket
locations.description: Tall pines stand close together. The wind through the needles sounds almost like voices.

locations.name: Abandoned Farmstead
locations.description: Collapsed fences and a half-burned farmhouse. Nature is reclaiming the place.

locations.name: Misty Hollow
locations.description: A low-lying hollow where mist never fully clears. Strange lights sometimes flicker between the trees.

locations.name: Ancient Stone Circle
locations.description: Weathered standing stones arranged in a rough circle. Faint carvings are still visible on some faces.

locations.name: Shallow River Crossing
locations.description: A broad, shallow stretch of river where the water runs clear over smooth stones.

locations.name: Hidden Bandit Camp
locations.description: A rough camp tucked between rocks. Smoke rises from a poorly hidden fire.

locations.name: Deep Woods
locations.description: The canopy is so thick that little sunlight reaches the ground. The silence feels deliberate.

locations.name: Crumbling Watchtower
locations.description: A stone tower leaning heavily to one side. The upper floors have long since collapsed.

locations.name: Sunken Path
locations.description: An old path that has sunk several feet below the surrounding ground. Roots and stone press in from both sides.
